title: Runtime dynamic import() needs files the bundler doesn't emit → copy in post-build
trigger: Library does internal dynamic import() of a file (e.g. .mjs, .wasm) at runtime, but bundler doesn't emit it to dist/
principle: Some libraries (ONNX Runtime Web, Emscripten modules) use internal dynamic import() or fetch() for files that the bundler can't statically analyze. The bundler emits the main module but not the runtime-imported satellite files. Fix with a post-build script that copies the missing files from node_modules to dist/assets/ with the exact filename the library expects.

cases.context: ONNX Runtime Web dynamically imports 'ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.mjs' at runtime — Vite doesn't emit it, causing 'Failed to fetch dynamically imported module' error
ORT expects wasmPaths as directory prefix but code passes full file path — ORT appends filename to the prefix, producing double filename

applyFor: ONNX Runtime Web in Vite/Webpack bundles
Emscripten modules with runtime dynamic imports
Any library with internal import() of satellite files not tracked by bundler
WASM libraries needing .wasm + .mjs files at specific paths
